leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a reactive data property to track the loading state of an asynchronous operation
Apply conditional rendering to display a loading indicator while data is being fetched
Construct a method that prevents duplicate API calls by checking the current loading state
Configure a watcher to trigger data fetching when a reactive dependency changes
Update component logic to cancel pending requests when new requests are initiated
Bind user interactions to methods that safely trigger asynchronous operations
Control the sequence of asynchronous operations to ensure data consistency
